about: The taps the engine will write and the reference adapter (models/glm5next/reference.py `taps`) writes, in program order. The first entry whose name matches, in its layers when given, applies; {nn} is a two-digit layer. The bundle's diagnostic-taps build writes them with CHOPINFER_TAPS_DIR set (bundle_glm5next::taps): the encoder entries as the shared encoder runtime captures them (bundle_glm5next::encoders::taps), and the text entries its text tap writer reads back after each stage of an eager target prefill (bundle_glm5next::taps::text, checked against this file), all replicated, from rank 0. The engine does not write attn.q, attn.k, attn.v, attn.core, the x.kda.*, x.indexer.k, moe.* and the hyper-connections' post and comb entries (it holds post and comb in BF16); the reference writes them.

Names follow docs/reference-runner.md ("Taps and tapdiff") (tools/refrun/taps.py's grammar). The reference taps the canonical names on the HF glm5_next modules: embed.out and L<nn>.in.streams the decoder layer's input (the four mHC streams); L<nn>.x.hc.attn.post, .comb and .x.hc.attn the attention hyper-connection's three outputs; L<nn>.attn.in input_layernorm; L<nn>.attn.q, .k, .v the KDA q_proj, k_proj, v_proj (KDA layers) or q_b_proj (latent attention layers); L<nn>.x.kda.* the forget gate, b_proj and o_norm's two inputs; L<nn>.x.q_latent q_a_layernorm, L<nn>.x.latent kv_a_layernorm, L<nn>.x.indexer.k and .ids the indexer's key norm and selected positions; L<nn>.attn.core the input of o_proj; L<nn>.attn.out self_attn; L<nn>.x.hc.mlp.* the MLP hyper-connection; L<nn>.mlp.in post_attention_layernorm; L<nn>.router.* mlp.gate's outputs 0 (logits), 1 (weights) and 2 (ids); L<nn>.moe.routed and .moe.shared the experts and shared experts; L<nn>.mlp.out mlp; L<nn>.out the layer's output streams; final.x.hc.head hc_head; final.norm the norm. enc.vision.out is model.visual.merger's output and enc.vision.B<nn>.out each vision block's output, as tools/refrun/encoder.py --blocks taps the declaration.

cols is the full width; a col_shards rank holds cols / ranks of it, its share of every [heads, dim] block. detail: written only in the layers CHOPINFER_TAPS_LAYERS names. The encoder taps are written from rank 0: the merged rows from the media arena, the block rows read back by the encoder runtime.
